title: Family with Children & Toy Wheelbarrow, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-20th-century outdoor black-and-white snapshot showing two women and two young boys posing outside next to a wire fence and wooden outbuildings. The children hold small wooden hand-crafted toys, including a toy wheelbarrow and a flatbed cart. The shadow of the person taking the photograph is clearly visible on the gravel driveway in the foreground.
